rootCause: Embedded ICC resource1039 was ignored; saved RGB device samples were rendered as unprofiled RGB, silently changing midtones and gamut.
change: Apply bounded ICC v2/v4 RGB matrix/TRC profiles using D50 PCS and media-relative sRGB conversion after source-precision white-matte removal. Expose applied/unsupported/invalid color metadata and clear it on file changes.

construction.oracle: LittleCMS 2.19 double RGB to sRGB8 relative colorimetric NOOPTIMIZE
axes: 9 independently generated ICC profiles: v2/v4 gamma, sampled curves and parametric types0–4
construction.sourceVerification: Saved profile bytes and every source plane round-trip byte-exact through psd-tools. LittleCMS consumes unmatted double RGB from actual saved samples; no tolerance or fitted conversion matrix.
construction.determinism: Color grid is deterministic, no random seed. ICC creation timestamp can vary between generations; committed goldens pin complete original hashes.

limitations: Scoped to saved RGB8/16 composites and ICC matrix/TRC input/display profiles with D50 XYZ PCS; no general LUT/device-link/CMYK/32-bit/HDR/layer recomposition or thumbnail certification.
Unsupported and malformed profiles preserve approximate legacy rendering with a visible warning. Mutated header/tag negative tests verify routing, not independent valid LUT rendering.

JPEG is lossy. Host JPEG and browser checks compare the same encoder fed independent expected RGBA; they do not claim lossless JPEG vs source. wx file I/O is mocked; native Chrome decodes actual output.
P3-primary gamma2.2 synthetic profile is not a claim of exact branded Display P3 transfer.
No WeChat developer-tools or physical-device verification for this change.
